title: Part Nine: What It Would Take

sections.brief: Six routes (city charter, state statute, state ballot, Congress, amendment, court) with what has passed through each: NYC 2019, Seattle, Takoma Park, Oakland; compact (Virginia 13 Apr 2026); Maine, Alaska, Arizona measures; Maine SJC limit; 2024 defeats; MI/OK/NV not on 2026 ballot; ECRA 2022; FRA, DISCLOSE 2026; Article V, Bayh-Celler, Democracy for All; opinion vs supermajority; courts (AIRC, Rucho, Moore, Baber, NRSC). Figures: flow (six routes); compare (every reform, route, status, date to watch)

Closing section in a plain, warm register: 3 Nov 2026 measures (Alaska Measure 2 with backers/opponents and money; MA Q3; Montana I-194; Honolulu, Irvine, Longmont), cross-party coalitions; what follows (compact, DISCLOSE/FRA, NRSC effects, Missouri); what anyone can do (primaries, matching and vouchers, signatures and measures, same standard for every spender); The test and the book's answer, linking de40_the_garden. Figures: time (dates to watch); stats (how many hands it took)
